name: The Crystal Cocoon Nursery
description: Giant translucent crystal cocoons hang from ancient tree branches, each containing a sleeping creature made of light and star dust, protected by a gentle aura of rainbow energy.
prompt: Enormous translucent crystal cocoons of various sizes hanging from the branches of ancient gnarled trees, each cocoon containing a sleeping ethereal creature made of swirling light and stardust, soft rainbow energy auras protecting each cocoon, magical forest at twilight with fireflies, moonlight filtering through the leaves, mystical and protective atmosphere, highly detailed fantasy art, dreamlike quality
caption: Guardians of dreams, wrapped in crystal light... 💎✨ What wonder would you protect in a shining cradle?
